name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.9 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 3 visits over 15 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 20 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 15 hours starting 2025-07-01, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 3.66 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
